---
title: "revealjs-anime example"
format:
  revealjs:
    revealjs-plugins:
      - revealjs-anime
    width: 1280
    height: 720
    include-in-header:
      - text: |
          <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/animejs@3.2.2/lib/anime.min.js"></script>
    include-after-body:
      - text: |
          <style>
            /* .invisible-fragment comes from the extension's stylesheet. */
            .pulse-target { display: block; text-align: center;
              font-size: 3em; color: #6f42c1; margin-top: 2em; }
            .typewriter-target { display: block; font-family: monospace;
              font-size: 1.4em; text-align: center; margin-top: 3em;
              min-height: 1.5em; }
            .hex-sticker { position: absolute; z-index: 0;
              pointer-events: none; opacity: 0; }
            .hexes-slide h2, .hexes-slide p { position: relative; z-index: 1; }

            /* Idle terminal. The caret blink is pure CSS: anime.js only ever
               writes .term-cmd's text, so the two never share a property. */
            .term { background: #1e1e2e; color: #cdd6f4; font-family: monospace;
              font-size: 1.3em; padding: 0.8em 1em; border-radius: 8px;
              text-align: left; min-height: 3em; margin-top: 1.5em; }
            .term-prompt { color: #a6e3a1; }
            .term-caret { animation: term-blink 1s steps(1) infinite; }
            @keyframes term-blink { 50% { opacity: 0; } }

            .formula-target, .loop-target { display: block; font-family: monospace;
              text-align: center; }
            .formula-target { font-size: 2.2em; color: #6f42c1; margin-top: 2em;
              white-space: nowrap; }
            .loop-target { font-size: 1.1em; white-space: pre; text-align: left;
              background: #f6f6f8; padding: 0.8em 1em; border-radius: 8px;
              min-height: 6em; margin-top: 1em; }

            /* Reviewer 2. CSS owns how the strike and cursor look; anime.js
               owns only the strike's width and the cursor's transform. */
            .reviewer-quote { display: inline-block; font-style: italic; }
            .reviewer-strike { position: absolute; height: 4px; width: 0;
              background: #c0392b; z-index: 3; pointer-events: none; }
            .reviewer-comment { color: #c0392b; font-style: italic;
              font-size: 0.8em; }
            .reviewer-caret { color: #c0392b; visibility: hidden;
              animation: term-blink 1s steps(1) infinite; }
            .anime-cursor { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; z-index: 4;
              pointer-events: none; display: flex; align-items: flex-start; }
            .anime-cursor-label { color: white; font-size: 12px;
              padding: 1px 6px; border-radius: 4px; margin-left: 2px;
              white-space: nowrap; }
          </style>
          <script src="example.js"></script>
---
